predictor.notes: The predictor matches all 24 observed prices exactly, using 24 business requests and 4 REA operations including inspection. It represents a 35,990-cent fixed fee plus marginal prices of 476 cents for units 1–295, 180 cents for units 296–719, and 47 cents thereafter. Observations at 294–296 and 718–720 directly support both transitions; additional samples span the domain through 1000. All responses reported roundingCents: 0. Eight alternate-estimate observations in session 2 also matched the model. Confidence is high, but unobserved quantities were not exhaustively verified, so additional localized pricing changes cannot be ruled out.
